We provide comprehensive environmental management solutions nationwide with strict legal compliance and guaranteed traceability. We specialize in the collection, transport, and certified final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste, as well as material destruction with notarial backing.
empresa.descMiddle: . We provide comprehensive environmental management solutions
empresa.descOutro: with strict legal compliance and guaranteed traceability. We specialize in the collection, transport, and certified final disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste, as well as material destruction with notarial backing.
empresa.missionDesc: Provide specialized corporate solutions for the collection, transport and destruction of waste, building lasting strategic alliances. We prioritize legal risk mitigation and environmental care, ensuring profitability and brand protection for our clients.
empresa.visionDesc: To consolidate ourselves as the national operational partner of reference in comprehensive waste management and notarial destruction of merchandise, applying cutting-edge technologies to drive the country's sustainable development.
empresa.valuesDesc: Our Integrated Management System (SIG) safeguards your operations. We work under the strictest ISO standards, guaranteeing impeccable, biosecure processes with absolute documentary support against any audit.

destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.heroTitle: Destruction of Products, Expired Merchandise and Industrial Materials
destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.heroSubtitle: Secure solutions for the disposal of obsolete inventories, shrinkages, and defective batches. We disable your merchandise to protect your brand's prestige, guaranteeing a responsible and certified final disposal.
destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I wish to quote the destruction of products and merchandise.
destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.section2Intro: We manage the physical disabling of goods that have lost their commercial value, preventing their entry into the informal market and protecting both consumers and your company.

products.title: Consumer and Personal Care Products
products.desc: Cosmetics, shampoos, creams, perfumes, beauty and personal care items with quality flaws, damaged packaging, or expired dates.

products.title: Food and Pharmaceutical Industry
products.desc: Batches of expired food and beverages, supplements, medical supplies, and products rejected by quality control.

products.title: Industrial Materials and Shrinkages
products.desc: Spare parts, auto parts, plastic components, returned packaging, branded containers, and production remainders.

products.title: General Merchandise and Retail
products.desc: Sunglasses, toys, household items, counterfeit products (seizures), or legally abandoned merchandise.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Collection and Reverse Logistics
cycleSteps.desc: We collect the merchandise directly from your warehouses, distribution centers, or customs, using appropriate vehicles and approved personnel for loads of any volume.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Secure Transport and Custody
cycleSteps.desc: We carry out direct and monitored transport to our operations plant, ensuring that no product is lost or diverted during the journey.

cycleSteps.title: 3. Destruction and Denaturation Process
cycleSteps.desc: We apply mechanical processes (shredding, compaction, or cutting) that completely render the product and its original packaging useless, making it unrecognizable.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Final Disposal and Certification
cycleSteps.desc: The generated waste is recovered (recycled) or disposed of in authorized landfills ecologically. We issue the Destruction and Disposal Certificate, a key document for your audits.

destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.whyTitle: Why trust ECO M with your inventories?

whyPoints.title: Brand and Reputation Protection
whyPoints.desc: We eliminate the risk of defective or expired products reaching the black market and damaging your company's image.

whyPoints.title: Space Liberation and Savings
whyPoints.desc: We help you quickly clear your warehouses of immobilized inventories, reducing your high logistical costs.

whyPoints.title: Legal Support and Transparency
whyPoints.desc: Our processes provide documentary support for the write-off of your assets in the face of inspections and quality controls.

destruccion-productos-mercaderia-materia.footerText: Do you need to write off a batch of products, destroy shrinkages, or free up space in your warehouse immediately? An ECO M specialist is ready to advise you.

destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.heroTitle: Notarial, Fiscal, and Customs Destruction (Inventory Write-offs)
destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.heroSubtitle: Absolute legal backing for tax deduction and expense support before SUNAT. We carry out the disabling of shrinkages and impairments with the presence of a Notary Public, ensuring tax and environmental compliance.
destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I need advice on notarial destruction and inventory write-offs before SUNAT.
destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.section2Intro: We execute destruction processes under the strict guidelines of the Income Tax Law and the General Customs Law, providing your accounting department with the required evidentiary documentation.

products.title: Impairment Write-offs (SUNAT)
products.desc: Destruction of merchandise that has lost its quality or commercial value (obsolete, expired, or deteriorated) with notarial presence, an indispensable requirement for tax deduction.

products.title: Notarial Destruction of Shrinkages
products.desc: Legal validation for quantitative losses of inputs generated during your productive or industrial process.

products.title: Fiscal and Customs Destruction
products.desc: Disposal of goods in a state of legal abandonment, administrative seizure, or restricted goods, under the direct supervision of customs authorities.

products.title: Fixed Asset Write-offs
products.desc: Disabling and destruction of depreciated machinery, furniture, or equipment that must be removed from your accounting books with proper notarial support.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Logistical and Legal Coordination
cycleSteps.desc: We advise your accounting team, schedule the pickup of the merchandise, and coordinate the presence of our allied Notary Public (or assigned SUNAT official).

cycleSteps.title: 2. Custodied Transport
cycleSteps.desc: We transport obsolete inventories from your distribution center to our authorized plant under strict security and traceability protocols.

cycleSteps.title: 3. On-site Destruction (Notarial Act)
cycleSteps.desc: We subject the goods to on-site shredding or compaction. The Notary or auditor verifies in situ that the merchandise is completely disabled.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Issuance of Act and Certificate
cycleSteps.desc: We deliver the Notarial Act of Destruction (evidentiary document for SUNAT) along with the Final Disposal Certificate (environmental backing for MINAM/OEFA).

destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.whyTitle: Why trust ECO M with your tax processes?

whyPoints.title: Guaranteed Tax Benefit
whyPoints.desc: We provide the exact support your financial area needs to deduct expenses and avoid contingencies or fines in SUNAT audits.

whyPoints.title: 100% Auditable and Transparent Process
whyPoints.desc: We offer photographic and video records of the entire operation for the support and archiving of your quality inspectors.

whyPoints.title: Strategic Notarial Alliances
whyPoints.desc: We work with Notaries Public specializing in industrial destruction processes, streamlining procedures and ensuring legal compliance.

destruccion-notarial-fiscal-aduanera.footerText: Do you have an upcoming accounting close and need to write off a batch of merchandise before SUNAT without setbacks? Our legal team is ready to assist you today.

destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.heroTitle: Secure Document and Confidential Archive Destruction
destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.heroSubtitle: We protect your company's most valuable asset: information. We guarantee the confidential and irretrievable shredding of your physical and accounting files, in strict compliance with the Personal Data Protection Law.
destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I request a quote for the confidential shredding of archives.
destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.section2Intro: Avoid corporate espionage and legal fines. We handle the definitive elimination of any physical media containing sensitive information about your company, employees, or clients.

products.title: Accounting and Financial Records
products.desc: Invoices, balance sheets, voided checks, bank statements, tax returns, and audit reports.

products.title: Legal and HR Documentation
products.desc: Expired contracts, payrolls, personnel files, resumes, confidentiality agreements, and medical records (ideal for the health sector).

products.title: Strategic and Commercial Information
products.desc: Printed databases, marketing strategies, blueprints, bids, customer lists, and budgets.

products.title: Minor Magnetic and Optical Media
products.desc: Destruction of CD-ROMs, DVDs, backup tapes, ID badges, credit cards, and corporate identification cards.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Confidential Collection
cycleSteps.desc: Our properly identified and approved personnel collect document boxes directly from your offices, ensuring no outsiders have access.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Chain of Custody Transport
cycleSteps.desc: We transport your files in closed, monitored units directly to our plant, ensuring uninterrupted custody from your door to the shredding zone.

cycleSteps.title: 3. High-Security Shredding
cycleSteps.desc: Documents undergo industrial cross-cut shredding, reducing paper to tiny particles (confetti), making reconstruction humanly impossible.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Recycling and Certificate Issuance
cycleSteps.desc: We promote the circular economy by sending shredded paper to cardboard recycling plants. Finally, we issue your Confidential Destruction Certificate.

destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.whyTitle: Why trust your archives to ECO M?

whyPoints.title: Total Legal Compliance
whyPoints.desc: We operate under the guidelines of Law No. 29733 (Personal Data Protection Law), preventing severe fines for your organization.

whyPoints.title: Valuable Space Recovery
whyPoints.desc: Free up entire offices or warehouses currently occupied by paper boxes accumulated over years and reduce storage costs.

whyPoints.title: Absolute Security and Discretion
whyPoints.desc: Shielded and auditable processes; your documents go from the container to the shredder without anyone reading a single page.

destruccion-segura-documentos-archivos.footerText: Do you need to purge your central archive, destroy old payrolls, or dispose of bank cards with maximum security? Our confidentiality team awaits you.

destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.heroTitle: Destruction of Technological Equipment, WEEE, and Secure Data Wiping
destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.heroSubtitle: We guarantee the physical disabling of your hardware and the irreversible elimination of confidential information. We protect your data and manage components under strict Peruvian environmental regulations.
destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I wish to quote technological equipment destruction and data wiping.
destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.section2Intro: We cover the comprehensive destruction of all types of Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) or technological obsolescence to prevent data leaks and protect your brand.

products.title: IT Equipment and Infrastructure
products.desc: Desktop computers (CPU), laptops, servers, hard drives (HDD and SSD), USB drives, motherboards, and routers.

products.title: Mobile Devices and Telecommunications
products.desc: Corporate cell phones (smartphones), tablets, iPads, two-way radios, IP phones, and telephone exchanges.

products.title: Peripherals and Accessories
products.desc: Monitors, screens, printers, photocopiers, keyboards, mice, headsets, POS terminals, and biometric clocks.

products.title: Energy Storage
products.desc: External batteries (power banks), UPS, chargers, power supplies, and cables.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Secure Collection and Custody
cycleSteps.desc: We collect equipment directly from your facilities using closed vans and trained personnel, guaranteeing traceability from minute one.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Logical Data Wiping (Digital Destruction)
cycleSteps.desc: Upon request, we apply secure data wiping to drives and memories before physical destruction, ensuring confidential data is 100% unrecoverable.

cycleSteps.title: 3. Physical Destruction and Shredding
cycleSteps.desc: We subject IT equipment to mechanical shredding processes. The hardware loses its original form, preventing branded parts from entering the black market.

cycleSteps.title: 4. WEEE Management and Final Disposal
cycleSteps.desc: The resulting fragments are properly managed as WEEE. We issue the Final Destruction and Disposal Certificate, valid before environmental authorities.

destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.whyTitle: Why trust ECO M with your technological assets?

whyPoints.title: Zero Risk of Data Leakage
whyPoints.desc: Total compliance for banks, clinics, insurance companies, and state entities.

whyPoints.title: Brand Protection
whyPoints.desc: We prevent the unauthorized secondary market of your decommissioned equipment.

whyPoints.title: Regulatory Compliance
whyPoints.desc: Processes aligned with the Personal Data Protection Law and the Solid Waste Management Law.

destruccion-equipos-tecnologicos-borrado.footerText: Do you have obsolete tech inventory or urgently need to destroy hard drives? An ECO M advisor is ready to help.

destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.heroTitle: Destruction of Textiles, Footwear, and Corporate Uniforms
destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.heroSubtitle: Protect your company's identity and prevent impersonation or fraud. We securely disable institutional garments, safety footwear, trims, and textile remnants to shield your brand's prestige.
destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I want to quote the disabling of textiles and corporate uniforms.
destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.section2Intro: Prevent your corporate clothing or defective products from ending up on the black market. We eliminate any item containing your logo, institutional colors, or intellectual property.

products.title: Uniforms and Institutional Clothing
products.desc: Workwear, embroidered shirts, reflective vests, jackets, overalls, and private security or law enforcement uniforms.

products.title: Industrial and Retail Footwear
products.desc: Decommissioned safety boots (PPE), corporate shoes, sneakers, and footwear batches with factory defects or counterfeits.

products.title: Trims, Supplies, and Production Scraps
products.desc: Woven or printed labels, custom shoelaces, branded soles, zippers, buttons, logo patches, and fabric rolls with registered prints.

products.title: Campaign Surpluses and Merchandising
products.desc: Unsold past-season clothing, corporate backpacks, caps, briefcases, and discontinued promotional items.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Secure Batch Collection
cycleSteps.desc: We collect batches of garments or footwear directly from your warehouses, factories, or stores, ensuring strict inventory control from the origin.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Chain of Custody Transport
cycleSteps.desc: We transport items to our plant in closed vehicles, preventing any risk of theft, loss, or diversion during transit.

cycleSteps.title: 3. Mechanical Destruction (Cutting and Shredding)
cycleSteps.desc: We use industrial guillotines and high-power shredders to cut textiles and chop footwear. We completely disable any logo, making reuse impossible.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Final Disposal and Certification
cycleSteps.desc: Disabled waste is managed environmentally (sent for textile recycling into industrial rags when viable). We finalize by delivering your Destruction Certificate.

destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.whyTitle: Why trust ECO M to protect your brand?

whyPoints.title: Prevention of Impersonation and Crimes
whyPoints.desc: Prevent unauthorized third parties from using uniforms with your company's name to commit fraud, theft, or damage your reputation.

whyPoints.title: Intellectual Property Protection
whyPoints.desc: We are the strategic ally of retail brands to ensure that counterfeits or flawed products never return to the market.

whyPoints.title: Environmental Care
whyPoints.desc: We promote the recovery and correct disposal of waste, helping to mitigate the environmental impact of the clothing industry.

destruccion-textiles-calzado-uniformes-c.footerText: Do you need to write off old uniforms, destroy branded trims, or disable safety footwear? Our operational team is prepared to protect your image today.

destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.heroTitle: Destruction of Regulated Goods (IQBF) and Hazardous Waste
destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.heroSubtitle: High-risk management with absolute regulatory compliance. We neutralize, destroy, and dispose of chemical inputs, dangerous goods, and regulated assets (SUNAT) under the strictest safety and environmental standards.
destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I require management for regulated goods or hazardous waste.
destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.section2Intro: Avoid legal and environmental contingencies. We have the infrastructure, permits, and qualified personnel for disabling toxic, flammable, or state-controlled materials.

products.title: Chemical Inputs and Regulated Goods (IQBF)
products.desc: Notarial and fiscal destruction of chemical products controlled by SUNAT (solvents, acids, acetone, etc.), ensuring they are not diverted to illicit activities.

products.title: Expired Industrial Products
products.desc: Batches of paints, lubricants, additives, resins, glues, and chemical reagents that have lost their useful life.

products.title: Contaminated Hazardous Waste (RESPEL)
products.desc: Containers, cylinders, absorbent pads, or packaging that have been in direct contact with toxic substances or hydrocarbons.

products.title: Biological and Sanitary Risk Materials
products.desc: Highly contaminated cosmetics or pharmaceuticals requiring special treatment before final disposal.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Evaluation and Contingency Plan
cycleSteps.desc: Our environmental engineers evaluate the safety data sheet (MSDS) of your products to determine the appropriate PPE, handling protocols, and safest destruction method.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Transport of Hazardous Materials (MTC)
cycleSteps.desc: We collect and transport the load using our specialized fleet authorized by the MTC for hazmat transport, ensuring total hermeticity on the route.

cycleSteps.title: 3. Treatment, Neutralization, and Destruction
cycleSteps.desc: We subject goods to physical-chemical neutralization, encapsulation, or controlled mechanical shredding, eliminating their hazard and denaturing the product.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Security Landfill Disposal and Certification
cycleSteps.desc: The resulting waste is confined in authorized security landfills. We finalize by issuing the Destruction Certificate and the Hazardous Waste Manifest.

destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.whyTitle: Why trust ECO M for high-risk operations?

whyPoints.title: Valid Licenses and Authorizations
whyPoints.desc: We operate strictly as a Solid Waste Operator Company (EO-RS) authorized by MINAM, DIGESA, and MTC.

whyPoints.title: SUNAT Legal Control for IQBF
whyPoints.desc: We provide traceability and notarial/fiscal support required to write off regulated goods without risk of penal or tax sanctions.

whyPoints.title: Zero Environmental and Occupational Risk
whyPoints.desc: Highly trained personnel in hazardous materials handling (MATPEL) and infrastructure that prevents any type of spill or contamination.

destruccion-bienes-fiscalizados-residuos.footerText: Do you need to manage expired chemical inputs or write off regulated goods urgently and securely? An ECO M engineer is ready to evaluate your requirements.

venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.heroTitle: Sale of Portable Toilets, Showers, and Sinks
venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.heroSubtitle: High-durability hygiene equipment for construction projects, mining camps, agriculture, and events. Direct sale of new modules, manufactured to withstand extreme climates, with warranty and immediate availability.
venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.whatsappMessage: Hello, I am on the ECO M website and I request a quote for the purchase of portable toilets, showers, or sinks.
venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.section2Intro: We provide 100% new equipment, made of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) with UV protection, designed to ensure hygiene and comply with occupational safety standards in your project.

products.title: Portable Toilets
products.desc: Autonomous toilets (Standard and VIP), easy to clean and maintain. Ideal for civil works, remote camps, agricultural use, or event venues. Robust structure and non-slip floor.

products.title: Portable Showers
products.desc: Individual shower modules ready to connect to the water network or elevated tanks. Spacious, hygienic, and with excellent drainage; the perfect solution for personnel hygiene in long-term camps.

products.title: Portable Sinks (Hygiene Stations)
products.desc: Autonomous or connectable washing stations. Designed with a foot pump (pedal) to avoid manual contact, fundamental to complying with health protocols (SSOMA) in dining rooms and site entrances.

cycleSteps.title: 1. Commercial Advisory
cycleSteps.desc: We help you size your purchase: we calculate the exact number of toilets, showers, or sinks your project needs according to the number of workers and current regulations.

cycleSteps.title: 2. Quotation and Acquisition
cycleSteps.desc: Agile sales process for companies. We issue formal quotes and offer competitive prices, with special discounts for volume purchases or bids.

cycleSteps.title: 3. Preparation and Dispatch
cycleSteps.desc: We prepare your equipment for immediate pickup at our plant in Lima or coordinate logistics for shipping to your site anywhere in Peru.

cycleSteps.title: 4. Delivery and Warranty
cycleSteps.desc: You receive completely new equipment ready to operate in your project, backed by our factory warranty against manufacturing defects and structural design.

venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.whyTitle: Why is it better to buy your own equipment with ECO M?

whyPoints.title: Profitability for your Project
whyPoints.desc: For medium and long-term projects, buying toilets represents a massive economic saving compared to high monthly rental costs. You invest in an asset that can be reused in future works.

whyPoints.title: Maximum Extreme Resistance
whyPoints.desc: Equipment injected to resist impacts, rough use, and designed with UV protection to withstand the intense sun of the Peruvian coast, highlands, and jungle.

whyPoints.title: Regulatory Compliance (SSOMA)
whyPoints.desc: Guarantee mandatory sanitary conditions for the well-being of your personnel definitively and raise your company's standards.

venta-banos-duchas-lavamanos-portatiles.footerText: Starting a new project or equipping a camp? Invest smartly in your own sanitary equipment. Request our sales catalog today.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Commitment to Security, Confidentiality, and Brand Protection
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We are the strategic ally of companies in Peru for the secure disabling of assets, destruction of confidential information, and shrinkage management under strict regulatory compliance.
aboutPage.intro1: At ECO M (Expert Destruction Management) we specialize in mitigating the operational, legal, and reputational risks of organizations. We understand that the accumulation of obsolete inventories, clothing with corporate logos, and the handling of archives with sensitive data represent a vulnerability for your company if they fall into the wrong hands.
aboutPage.intro2: We design and implement processes of physical destruction and irreversible disabling, operating under the environmental regulations of MINAM/OEFA and providing the notarial support required by SUNAT for the deduction of shrinkages and impairments in the Income Tax.
aboutPage.missionText: To protect the prestige and intellectual property of our clients through shielded destruction processes, guaranteeing full traceability, legal compliance, and environmentally responsible final disposal.
aboutPage.visionText: To be the benchmark company in Peru in corporate destruction management and brand protection, recognized for our operational rigor, transparency, and excellence in B2B service.
aboutPage.p1Text: Protecting our clients' information is an absolute priority. We maintain a strict chain of custody from collection to final shredding.
aboutPage.p2Text: We execute each procedure with notarial presence and auditable documentation to guarantee the validity of the process before SUNAT.
aboutPage.p3Text: We prioritize waste recovery (recycling of paper, cardboard, and metals) and responsible disposal to reduce environmental impact.
aboutPage.p4Text: Agile responses and logistics solutions adapted to the scale and specific needs of each industry.
aboutPage.g1Text: Photographic and video record of destruction processes for files and internal audits.
aboutPage.g2Text: Issuance of Destruction Certificates and Waste Management Manifests valid before competent authorities.
aboutPage.g3Text: Mechanical disabling of uniforms, packaging, and products to eradicate any risk of counterfeiting or informal marketing.
aboutPage.ctaTitle: Looking for a reliable ally for the protection of your brand and the secure write-off of your assets?
